question: Identify the incorrect pair (River and its origin) from the following.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna - Brahmagri range**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Krishna River **originates from the **Mahabaleshwar **region in the Western Ghats, not the Brahmagri range.
 
• **Godavari** originates from the **Nasik district**.
 
• **Tapi** originates from the **Satpura ranges**.
 
• **Narmada** originates from the **Amarkantak hills**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Godavari** is the **second longest river in India**, flowing eastward across the Deccan Plateau.
 
• The **Krishna** River is one of the longest rivers in India, flowing through **Maharashtra, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• The **Narmada** River flows westward and is one of the major rivers in central India.
 
• The **Tapi** River flows westward through **central India and into the Arabian Sea**.
 
• The correct understanding of river origins is crucial for geographical and environmental studies.
